patch.summary:
Choose Adobe Firefly only if your buying job matches “Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99;” rather than n8n's shape. Choose n8n only if your buying job matches “Workflow automation — Community self-host free; Cloud Starter €20/mo annual (2.5k executio” rather than Adobe Firefly's shape. Workflow advantage: Adobe Firefly leans ai-image; n8n leans ai-automation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Adobe Firefly is Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99; also bundled in Creative Cloud.; n8n is Workflow automation — Community self-host free; Cloud Starter €20/mo annual (2.5k executions + AI credits); Pro €50; Business €667; Enterpri.
- Workflow coverage skew: Adobe Firefly-leaning ai-image vs n8n-leaning ai-automation.
- Researched limits: Adobe Firefly — Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; n8n — Cloud prices are EUR — startingPriceMonthly 20 is the Starter euro floor, not a USD SKU.

Limitations — Adobe Firefly: Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; Standalone pricing is easy to confuse with Creative Cloud Pro bundles; n8n: Cloud prices are EUR — startingPriceMonthly 20 is the Starter euro floor, not a USD SKU; Community Edition is self-host ops work — not a hosted Free Zapier-style 100-task sandbox.
